```{r setup}
myPath <- "path_to_github" #ADD PATH TO GITHUB FOLDER

#load functions
source(paste0(myPath, "/functions/downstreamAnalysisFunctions.R"))

# import metadata
metadata_all<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/metadata.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# read in relevant files
ctcf_peaks_counts_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/correctedCounts/CTCF/ctcf_ctcfPeaks_correctedCounts.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctcf_meta<-metadata_all[rownames(metadata_all) %in% colnames(ctcf_peaks_counts_corrected),]

ctcf_peakList<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,'/consensusPeaks/CTCF_consensusPeakset_SAF.txt'), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)
annoFile<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/annotations/tss1000_condensed_SAF.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)

#only want the protein coding genes
annoFile_pcg<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/annotations/pcgSAF.txt"), check.names=FALSE,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header=TRUE)
annoFile<-annoFile[annoFile$Gene%in% annoFile_pcg$GeneID,]

ctcf_peakListAnno<-annotatePeakFile(ctcf_peakList, annoFile)
ctcf_peakListAnnoX<-ctcf_peakListAnno[ctcf_peakListAnno$Chr=="chrX",]

ctcf_ctcfPeaklm_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/CTCF/ctcf_ctcfPeaks_lm_corrected.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

```


# Track Plotting


# Linear modeling graphs 

```{r linearModelingPlots}

#For PRPS2, need promoter levels rather than peak (there is no promoter peak for PRPS2)

ctcf_promoter_lcl_counts_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath, "/correctedCounts/CTCF/ctcf_tss1000_correctedCounts.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctcf_promoterLm_corrected<-read.delim(paste0(myPath,"/linearModeling/corrected/CTCF/ctcf_tss1000_lm_corrected.txt"), check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ctcf_promoterLm_maxTSS<-maxTSS(ctcf_promoterLm_corrected)

# Figure 4B: PRPS2
PRPS2_ctcf_lcl_promoter<-plotgene('PRPS2_1', 'X', metaFile,ctcf_promoter_lcl_counts_corrected, 'CTCF',0,80, 'blue' )
PRPS2_ctcf_lcl_promoter_line<-addLineInfo('PRPS2',ctcf_promoterLm_maxTSS, PRPS2_ctcf_lcl_promoter )
print(PRPS2_ctcf_peaks_line)

# Figure 4D: KDM6A
KDM6A_ctcf_peaks<-plotgene('Peak_32889', 'X', metaFile,ctcf_peaks_counts_corrected, 'CTCF',0,80, 'black' )
KDM6A_ctcf_peaks_line<-addLineInfo("Peak_32889", ctcf_ctcfPeaklm_corrected,KDM6A_ctcf_peaks)
print(KDM6A_ctcf_peaks_line)


```

# Compare Xi-silent vs Xi-expressed genes on Xa and Xi
```{r silVexp}
ctcf_peakLm_X$PeakID<-rownames(ctcf_peakLm_X)
ctcf_peakLm_X<-peakGeneMatch(ctcf_peakLm_X, ctcf_peakListAnnoX)
ctcf_peakLm_X<-expStatus(ctcf_peakLm_X)


ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS<-maxTSS(ctcf_peakLm_X)
ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$xciStatus_lcl<-factor(ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$xciStatus_lcl, levels=c("Xi-silent", "Xi-expressed", "not expressed", "XIST", "no XCI call"))
xaXicolorList_ctcf<-c("Xi-silent"="navyblue", "Xi-expressed"="lightblue", "XIST"="black", "not expressed"="grey60")

# Figure 4E: boxplot
ctcfPeaks_xa_xi_box<-formatPlot(xa_xi_box(ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS,"LCL")+scale_fill_manual(values=xaXicolorList_ctcf)+xlab("XCI Status")+ylab("CTCF Level \n (Normalized counts)"))+theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+ylim(NA,40)

# Figure 4F: Xa v Xi scatterplot
ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$label<-NA
ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$label[ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$Gene %in% c("PRPS2", "KDM6A", "NAP1L3", "XIST")]<-ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS[ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$Gene %in% c("PRPS2", "KDM6A", "NAP1L3", "XIST"),]$Gene

ctcf_xa_xi_scatter<-formatPlot(ggplot(data=ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS[ctcf_peakLm_X_maxTSS$xciStatus %in% c("no XCI call", "none") ==FALSE,], mapping=aes(x=intercept_ctcf_corrected, y=x_coeff_ctcf_corrected, color=xciStatus, label=label))+
                                 geom_point(size=3, alpha=0.7)+scale_color_manual(values=xcicolorList_ctcf)+theme_classic()+
                                 xlab("CTCF Level on Xa")+ylab("CTCF Level on Xi")+
                                 geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme(aspect.ratio = 1)+
                                 geom_label_repel(alpha=0.7))+xlim(-2.5,50)+ylim(-2.5,50)

# Figure 4I: deltaCTCF.x violin plot
ctcf_peakLm_X_summed<-sumPeaksbyGene(ctcf_peakLm_X)

ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$deltactcf.x<-ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff/ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his
ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$deltactcf.x_err<-sqrt((((ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff)^2)/((ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his)^2))*(((ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff_err^2))/(ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$x_his_coeff^2) +(ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his_err^2/ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$intercept_his^2)))


xist_int<-ctcf_peakLm_X_summed[ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$Gene=="XIST",]$intercept_his
xist_slope<-ctcf_peakLm_X_summed[ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$Gene=="XIST",]$x_his_coeff

ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$deltactcf.x[ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$Gene=="XIST"]<-xist_slope/(xist_int+xist_slope)
ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$xciStatus_lcl<-factor(ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$xciStatus_lcl, levels=c("Xi-silent", "Xi-expressed", "not expressed", "XIST", "no XCI call"))


dctcf_peak_vio<-formatPlot(ggplot(data=ctcf_peakLm_X_summed[ctcf_peakLm_X_summed$xciStatus_lcl != "no XCI call",], mapping=aes(x=xciStatus_lcl, y=deltactcf.x, fill=xciStatus_lcl))+geom_violin(trim=FALSE)+geom_boxplot(width=0.03, fill="white", outlier.shape = NA)+
                              scale_fill_manual(values=xcicolorList_ctcf)+theme_classic()+scale_color_manual(values=xcicolorList_ctcf)+xlab("XCI Status"))+theme(aspect.ratio=1)
```
